description: This Java class 'DefaultStreamConfig' provides a default implementation of the 'StreamConfig' interface. It encapsulates configuration settings related to streaming, such as maximum array size, write interval, ask timeout, retrieval configuration, persistence stream configuration, and stream cache configuration. It includes factory methods to create instances from a configuration object, and overrides for equals, hashCode, and toString methods.

classes.name: DefaultStreamConfig
classes.description: A final class implementing StreamConfig interface, providing default streaming configuration based on provided Config object.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to create an instance of DefaultStreamConfig from a Config object.

methods.name: getMaxArraySize
methods.description: Returns the maximum array size configured.

methods.name: getRetrievalConfig
methods.description: Returns the retrieval stream stage configuration.
